bodies: National Registry of Food Safety Professionals
International Association of Exhibitions and Events

exams.name: ACF Certified Chef de Cuisine
exams.blurb: Credential for chefs supervising a single kitchen unit, combining written testing, practical cooking and management coursework.

exams.name: ACF Certified Culinarian
exams.blurb: Entry professional cook credential requiring written and practical examinations plus documented commercial kitchen experience.

exams.name: ACF Certified Culinary Administrator
exams.blurb: Executive-level credential for culinary operations leaders covering business management, human resources and food service strategy.

exams.name: ACF Certified Culinary Educator
exams.blurb: Credential for post-secondary culinary instructors combining cooking practical assessment with teaching and curriculum evaluation.

exams.name: ACF Certified Executive Chef
exams.blurb: Senior credential for chefs managing multi-outlet kitchens, assessed on advanced cookery, nutrition, cost control and supervision.

exams.name: ACF Certified Executive Pastry Chef
exams.blurb: Senior pastry credential covering department management, advanced showpiece work, plated desserts and production costing.

exams.name: ACF Certified Fundamentals Cook
exams.blurb: Graduate-level entry credential for culinary school leavers assessed on basic cooking methods, sanitation and knife skills.

exams.name: ACF Certified Fundamentals Pastry Cook
exams.blurb: Entry pastry credential for programme graduates covering doughs, batters, custards, sanitation and basic decoration work.

exams.name: ACF Certified Master Chef
exams.blurb: Highest ACF credential awarded after an eight-day practical examination spanning global cuisines, baking, nutrition and buffet work.

exams.name: ACF Certified Master Pastry Chef
exams.blurb: Highest pastry credential requiring a multi-day practical spanning chocolate, sugar, plated desserts, breads and showpieces.

exams.name: ACF Certified Pastry Culinarian
exams.blurb: Entry pastry professional credential assessed on cakes, doughs, creams, sanitation and bakeshop production fundamentals.

exams.name: ACF Certified Secondary Culinary Educator
exams.blurb: Credential for high school culinary teachers combining cooking practical assessment with secondary teaching competency review.

exams.name: ACF Certified Sous Chef
exams.blurb: Supervisory kitchen credential assessed on production cooking, station management, food cost basics and sanitation leadership.

exams.name: ACF Certified Working Pastry Chef
exams.blurb: Mid-level pastry credential for chefs supervising bakeshop staff, covering production planning, decoration and cost control.

exams.name: ACS Certified Cheese Professional
exams.blurb: Examination covering cheesemaking, affinage, handling, sales and regulation for cheesemongers, buyers and cheesemakers.

exams.name: Advanced Cicerone
exams.blurb: Third-level beer credential with written, tasting and demonstration components covering brewing, service and off-flavour analysis.

exams.name: Advanced Sommelier Certificate
exams.blurb: Third-level sommelier examination with theory, blind tasting and service components required before attempting the Master diploma.

exams.name: Always Food Safe Food Protection Manager Certification
exams.blurb: ANSI-CFP accredited food protection manager examination delivered online with remote proctoring and accepted by most jurisdictions.

exams.name: BarSmarts Advanced
exams.blurb: Spirits and cocktail curriculum with a written examination and practical drink-making assessment for professional bartenders.

exams.name: BJCP Beer Judge Examination
exams.blurb: Online entrance examination plus tasting examination that ranks beer judges from Recognized through National and Master levels.

exams.name: BRCGS Professional
exams.blurb: Structured training and examination programme on the BRCGS global food safety standard for site practitioners and auditors.

exams.name: Certified Beer Server
exams.blurb: First-level beer credential testing storage, draught service, styles and off-flavours for front-line hospitality staff.

exams.name: Certified Cicerone
exams.blurb: Second-level beer credential combining written, tasting and demonstration testing on styles, service, pairing and draught systems.

exams.name: Certified Dietary Manager, Certified Food Protection Professional
exams.blurb: Credentialing examination for foodservice directors in healthcare and schools covering nutrition, sanitation and department management.

exams.name: Certified Professional – Food Safety
exams.blurb: Credential for food safety professionals and regulators covering inspection, risk assessment, HACCP and outbreak investigation.

exams.name: Certified Sommelier Examination
exams.blurb: Second-level sommelier examination testing theory, deductive blind tasting and restaurant wine service under timed conditions.

exams.name: Certified Specialist of Spirits
exams.blurb: Written examination covering distillation, spirit categories, production regions, regulation and responsible service.

exams.name: Certified Specialist of Wine
exams.blurb: Hundred-question written examination on viticulture, vinification, wine regions, laws and faults with no tasting component.

exams.name: Certified Wine Educator
exams.blurb: Advanced credential combining theory, essay, blind tasting and a teaching demonstration for professional wine instructors.

exams.name: FSPCA Foreign Supplier Verification Programs Course
exams.blurb: FDA-recognised curriculum training importers to evaluate foreign suppliers and document verification activities under FSMA.

exams.name: FSPCA Preventive Controls Qualified Individual – Animal Food
exams.blurb: FDA-recognised course qualifying individuals to develop and oversee animal food safety plans required under FSMA rules.

exams.name: FSPCA Preventive Controls Qualified Individual – Human Food
exams.blurb: Standardised FSMA curriculum qualifying staff to write and manage hazard analysis and risk-based preventive controls plans.

exams.name: HACCP Manager Certification
exams.blurb: Accredited training and examination on the seven HACCP principles, prerequisite programmes and food safety plan verification.

exams.name: IACP Certified Culinary Professional
exams.blurb: Credential for food writers, teachers and consultants assessed on culinary knowledge, communication and professional practice.

exams.name: Introductory Sommelier Course and Examination
exams.blurb: Two-day course and written examination introducing wine regions, viticulture, spirits and professional beverage service.

exams.name: KCBS Certified Barbecue Judge
exams.blurb: Class and assessment training judges to score competition barbecue on appearance, taste and tenderness under sanctioned rules.

exams.name: Learn2Serve Alcohol Seller-Server Training
exams.blurb: National responsible alcohol service course on intoxication signs, age verification and liability, with separate state-approved versions.

exams.name: Learn2Serve Food Protection Manager Certification
exams.blurb: ANSI-CFP accredited manager-level food safety examination covering temperature control, contamination, cleaning and HACCP basics.

exams.name: Master Cicerone
exams.blurb: Highest beer credential with a two-day written, tasting and oral examination held for a small number of candidates each year.

exams.name: Master Sommelier Diploma Examination
exams.blurb: Final sommelier examination with oral theory, blind tasting of six wines and practical service, passed by very few candidates.

exams.name: NRFSP Food Protection Manager Certification
exams.body: National Registry of Food Safety Professionals
exams.blurb: ANSI-CFP accredited manager certification examination accepted by state and local health departments across the country.

exams.name: Produce Safety Alliance Grower Training
exams.blurb: FDA-recognised course satisfying the Produce Safety Rule requirement for at least one trained supervisor per covered farm.

exams.name: Prometric Certified Professional Food Manager
exams.blurb: ANSI-CFP accredited food protection manager examination delivered at Prometric centres and through approved remote proctoring.

exams.name: Q Arabica Grader Certification
exams.blurb: Multi-day sensory and analytical examination series licensing graders to score arabica coffee against international standards.

exams.name: SCA Coffee Skills Program Professional Diploma
exams.blurb: Modular written and practical assessments across barista skills, brewing, green coffee, roasting and sensory analysis.

exams.name: ServSafe Alcohol Advanced Certification
exams.blurb: Advanced responsible alcohol service examination for managers covering policy, documentation, intervention and liability exposure.

exams.name: ServSafe Alcohol Primary Certification
exams.blurb: Responsible alcohol service training and examination on intoxication assessment, identification checks and refusal techniques.

exams.name: ServSafe Allergens Certification
exams.blurb: Online course and assessment on major food allergens, cross-contact prevention, labelling and guest communication procedures.

exams.name: ServSafe Food Handler Certificate
exams.blurb: Entry-level food safety course and assessment for line staff covering hygiene, time and temperature control and cleaning.

exams.name: ServSafe Food Protection Manager Certification
exams.blurb: Most widely accepted ANSI-CFP accredited manager food safety examination, valid five years in most United States jurisdictions.

exams.name: ServSafe Workplace
exams.blurb: Training suite for restaurant employers covering harassment prevention, unconscious bias and workplace conduct expectations.

exams.name: SQF Practitioner Training
exams.blurb: Required training pathway for the site practitioner who maintains a Safe Quality Food system under the SQF codes.

exams.name: StateFoodSafety Certified Food Protection Manager
exams.blurb: ANSI-CFP accredited food protection manager examination offered in testing centres and via online proctoring nationwide.

exams.name: TIPS Alcohol Server Certification
exams.blurb: Long-established responsible alcohol service training and test used nationally, with separate state-approved course versions.

exams.name: WSET Level 1 Award in Wines
exams.blurb: Beginner wine qualification with a thirty-question examination on main grape varieties, styles, storage and food pairing.

exams.name: WSET Level 2 Award in Wines
exams.blurb: Intermediate wine qualification examining grape varieties, principal regions, production factors and systematic tasting.

exams.name: WSET Level 3 Award in Wines
exams.blurb: Advanced wine qualification with multiple-choice, short-written and blind tasting papers on production factors and style drivers.

exams.name: WSET Level 4 Diploma in Wines
exams.blurb: Six-unit expert qualification covering wine production, business, regions, sparkling and fortified wines plus an independent assignment.

exams.name: Certified Club Manager
exams.blurb: Examination for private club managers covering governance, membership, food and beverage, golf operations and club finance.

exams.name: Certified Destination Management Executive
exams.blurb: Executive programme for destination marketing organisation leaders covering strategy, vision, stakeholder relations and change.

exams.name: Certified Food and Beverage Executive
exams.blurb: Credential for hotel food and beverage directors covering outlet operations, cost control, service standards and staffing.

exams.name: Certified Front Desk Representative
exams.blurb: Line-level credential covering reservations, check-in and check-out, guest requests, payment handling and property systems.

exams.name: Certified Government Meeting Professional
exams.blurb: Credential for planners working under federal travel and procurement rules, covering per diem, contracting and ethics.

exams.name: Certified Guest Service Professional
exams.blurb: Entry hospitality credential focused on guest interaction standards, problem resolution and service recovery techniques.

exams.name: Certified Hospitality Department Trainer
exams.blurb: Credential for hotel staff who deliver on-the-job training, covering task breakdowns, coaching and performance follow-up.

exams.name: Certified Hospitality Housekeeping Executive
exams.blurb: Credential for executive housekeepers covering staffing, inventory, cleaning standards, safety and budget management.

exams.name: Certified Hospitality Revenue Manager
exams.blurb: Credential covering hotel demand forecasting, rate strategy, distribution channels and revenue performance measurement.

exams.name: Certified Hospitality Sales Professional
exams.blurb: Credential for hotel sales staff covering prospecting, group business, contract negotiation and account management practice.

exams.name: Certified Hospitality Supervisor
exams.blurb: Supervisory credential covering scheduling, coaching, conflict handling and departmental communication in lodging operations.

exams.name: Certified Hotel Administrator
exams.blurb: Flagship credential for general managers and hotel executives, examining rooms, food service, finance, marketing and leadership.

exams.name: Certified in Exhibition Management
exams.body: International Association of Exhibitions and Events
exams.blurb: Modular programme and examinations covering exhibition operations, floor plan design, exhibitor sales and event marketing.

exams.name: Certified Meeting Management
exams.blurb: Senior credential for meeting executives covering strategic meetings management, business acumen and organisational leadership.

exams.name: Certified Meeting Professional
exams.blurb: Leading meetings credential examining strategic planning, project management, risk, site selection, marketing and stakeholders.

exams.name: Certified Meeting Professional – Healthcare
exams.blurb: Subspecialty for CMP holders covering healthcare meeting compliance, transparency reporting and continuing education requirements.

exams.name: Certified Rooms Division Executive
exams.blurb: Credential for rooms division leaders covering front office, housekeeping, reservations, yield management and guest services.

exams.name: Certified Special Events Professional
exams.blurb: Credential for live event producers covering design, production, budgeting, risk management and client relationship practice.

exams.name: Certified Travel Associate
exams.blurb: Credential for travel advisers with at least a year of experience, covering destinations, selling skills and client service.

exams.name: Certified Travel Counselor
exams.blurb: Advanced travel adviser credential covering management, marketing strategy and business development for experienced counsellors.

exams.name: Certified Travel Industry Executive
exams.blurb: Executive credential for travel suppliers and agency leaders covering distribution strategy, finance and industry management.

exams.name: Certified Wedding Planner
exams.blurb: Training and assessment covering wedding design, vendor contracts, timelines, budgets and day-of coordination practice.

exams.name: Digital Event Strategist
exams.blurb: Credential covering the design, production and measurement of virtual and hybrid events for meeting professionals.

exams.name: IATA Foundation in Travel and Tourism Diploma
exams.blurb: Entry diploma with examinations covering geography, air fares, ticketing procedures and customer service for travel agents.
